// flag. Available
//\nvalues are:
//\n    0:  Unknown or unspecified
//\n    1:  SSE             -msse
//\n    2:  SSE2            -msse2 # Minimum on x86_64
//\n    3:  SSE3            -msse3
//\n    4:  SSSE3           -mssse3
//\n    5:  SSE4.1          -msse4.1
//\n    6:  SSE4.2          -msse4.2 # Minimum recommended where
// supported
//\n    7:  AVX             -mavx
//\n    8:  AVX2            -mavx2
//\n    9:  AVX512F         -mavx512f
//\n    10: AVX512BW/DQ/VL  -mavx512bw -mavx512dq -mavx512vl
